subject: AWS/GCP marketplace annual recertification + ops playbook
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@amazon.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace annual recertification and updated fee schedule

Hi Tessa / Marissa —

Quick heads up from the AWS partner enablement team: we’re starting the annual recertification cycle for marketplace listings. For this year there are two items that will affect Redwood:

- a renewal recert checklist (technical and commercial items) that partners must return by 2026-10-01
- a modest marketplace fee adjustment for selected segments (details attached) taking effect 2026-11-01

I’ve attached the checklist and the fee summary. We’d like to schedule a 30-min alignment call next week to walk through the cert items that require product evidence and to confirm commercial changes. Proposed slots: Tue 9/14 10:00 or Thu 9/16 09:00 PT.

Action items for you (short):
- confirm who from Redwood will own technical evidence (screenshots, deployment docs)
- flag any commercial concerns so we can loop in partner ops early

Attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Recert_Checklist_2026.pdf

Best,
Ellen Park
Partner Manager — AWS Marketplace
E: ellen.park@amazon.com
T: +1 (206) 555-0143
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace annual recertification and updated fee schedule

Thanks Ellen — copying the internal ops group.

Summary for Redwood team: Ellen says the recert is due 10/01 and there is a fee change we should review. We need to treat this as a combined technical/commercial run (not just a form).

Immediate asks:
- Karthik: can you run a quick P&L impact using the Q3 marketplace mix and show estimated monthly delta from the fee change? Please include both gross and net (post-commissions) numbers. Need this by EOD Mon 9/13.
- Marissa: own partner outreach and schedule the AWS call. If Ellen’s times don’t work, propose two alternatives.
- Marcus: look for any contract constraints around fees and marketplace amendments — do we have a clause requiring 60-day notice or an amendment type?

I’ll draft an ops playbook skeleton and attach a consolidated evidence list for engineering.

Let’s keep replies brief — if you take an action, mark it done inline.

–Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace & Channels)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace annual recertification and updated fee schedule

Quick analysis (high level) based on Q3 marketplace telemetry:

- Estimated incremental cost to Redwood if the mid-tier fee applies: ~$18k/month (range $12k–$25k depending on SKU mix).
- Net impact after channel commissions: ~$12k/month.
- Biggest levers: (1) move higher-revenue SKUs to Dedicated listing where fee structure is different; (2) negotiate a staged implementation window.

Suggested negotiation points to raise with Ellen:
- ask for a 90-day implementation (instead of 30) to allow channel migration
- request fee grandfathering for accounts with active contracts expiring in next 180 days

I’ll run a more detailed SKU-level breakout on Mon and attach to the ops playbook.

Karthik
VP Sales — Americas
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace annual recertification and updated fee schedule

Couple legal/finance notes:

- Contract mechanics: our current Marketplace Addendum allows AWS to update standard fees with 30 days notice unless a specific contract amendment exists. There is not an automatic grandfathering clause in our template.
- Commercial workaround: we can request a short-term credit or promotional credit to offset implementation impact — historically partners have secured one cycle of promotional credit for material program changes.
- DocuSign: if we pursue an amendment, I can prepare a one-page amendment (term + fee schedule) and route for signatures. Please confirm if we want to push for a staged implementation or immediate ceiling cap.

I’ve attached a redline checklist and a short note for finance to evaluate the requested credit amount (Marcus_Finance_ask.txt).

Attachments: Recert_Change_Log_Summary.txt

Marcus Lin
General Counsel (Contracts) — Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@amazon.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@gcp-partners.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS/GCP marketplace annual recertification and ops playbook (next steps)

Ellen / Nina — thanks for the heads up. To keep things tight on our side, we’ve created an ops playbook and prioritized evidence requests. I’ve attached the consolidated checklist and fee schedule for both marketplaces.

Next steps (Redwood):
- Marissa to schedule a joint 30-min call with AWS on Tue 9/21 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow).
- Karthik to share SKU-level delta and a proposed mitigation plan by Mon 9/20.
- Marcus to prepare a one-page amendment template and a finance ask for a promotional credit.
- Tessa to own submission of technical evidence (screenshots, deployment notes) by 9/28.

Attachments: AWS_Marketplace_Recert_Checklist_2026.pdf, GCP_Listing_Fee_Schedule_Q4_2026.xlsx

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9482 | Ops ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-3124

If Ellen/Nina can confirm whether AWS/GCP will consider a 60–90 day implementation window, that will be our primary ask on the call.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partnerships (Marketplace & Channels)
